name: Brent Crude Oil Rips & G10 FX: Demand vs Supply Shock Regime Comparison
description: Event study analyzing USD/CAD, EUR/USD, and AUD/USD forward returns (5d, 10d, 20d) following Brent crude oil rip events (63-day rolling return crossing above 30%, 63-bar cooldown). Events are split into two regimes: Demand-Driven (2009, 2020 — post-crisis recoveries) and Supply Shock (2008, 2011, 2022 — GFC run-up, Arab Spring, Russia/Ukraine). Includes a Brent rolling return chart, two side-by-side cs_bars charts comparing FX forward returns by regime, a combined summary table with event counts, avg returns, and hit rates for both regimes, and separate event markers (green for demand, red for supply).
source:
# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE OIL RIPS & G10 FX: USD/CAD, EUR/USD AND AUD/USD FORWARD RETURNS
# =============================================================================
# Event: Brent crude 63-day rolling return crosses above 30%
#        with a 63-bar cooldown between events (debounce)
# FX convention:
#   USDCAD: positive return = USD stronger / CAD weaker
#   EURUSD: positive return = EUR stronger / USD weaker
#   AUDUSD: positive return = AUD stronger / USD weaker (commodity currency)
# Hit rate direction:
#   USDCAD: hit = return < 0 (CAD strengthens, USDCAD falls)
#   EURUSD: hit = return > 0 (EUR strengthens, EURUSD rises)
#   AUDUSD: hit = return > 0 (AUD strengthens, AUDUSD rises)
# Forward returns: 5d, 10d, 20d post-event (look-ahead, event study only)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# BRENT CRUDE DATA (SC FUTURES — continuous series)
# =============================================================================

brent_raw = reference_futures(ticker="SC")()
brent_cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(brent_raw.o, brent_raw.h, brent_raw.l, brent_raw.c, brent_raw.v, brent_raw.oi, brent_raw.s)
brent_close = ffill(brent_cont.c)

# =============================================================================
# BRENT 63-DAY ROLLING RETURN (bar-based lag — single reference asset)
# =============================================================================

brent_63d_ago = brent_close >> 63
brent_63d_ret = (brent_close - brent_63d_ago) / brent_63d_ago

# =============================================================================
# EVENT DETECTION: First cross above 30% with 63-bar cooldown
# =============================================================================

# Raw crossover: first bar where 63d return crosses above 30%
raw_cross = crossover(brent_63d_ret, 0.30)

# Debounce: suppress if previous crossover was < 63 bars ago
# barssince(raw_cross >> 1) = bars since last crossover on any prior bar
bars_since_prev = coalesce(barssince()(raw_cross >> 1), 999)
is_oil_rip = raw_cross and (bars_since_prev >= 63)

# =============================================================================
# REGIME CLASSIFICATION: Demand-Driven vs Supply Shock (by event year)
# =============================================================================

# Extract calendar year from each bar's timestamp
bar_year = datetime_extract(component='year')(index())

# Demand-driven: 2009 (GFC recovery), 2020 (COVID demand bounce)
# Supply shock:  2008 (GFC run-up), 2011 (Arab Spring), 2022 (Russia/Ukraine)
# All other years: Other/Mixed (not used in the two main regime charts)
is_demand_year  = (bar_year == 2009) or (bar_year == 2020)
is_supply_year  = (bar_year == 2008) or (bar_year == 2011) or (bar_year == 2022)

# Regime-gated event flags
is_demand_rip = is_oil_rip and is_demand_year
is_supply_rip = is_oil_rip and is_supply_year

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURNS FOR FX PAIRS (look-ahead — event study methodology)
# =============================================================================

# Raw FX forward returns (positive = pair appreciated)
fx_post5d  = ((close_fx << 5)  - close_fx) / close_fx
fx_post10d = ((close_fx << 10) - close_fx) / close_fx
fx_post20d = ((close_fx << 20) - close_fx) / close_fx

# Brent return on event bar (for event marker context)
ev_brent_ret_demand = where(is_demand_rip, brent_63d_ret)
ev_brent_ret_supply = where(is_supply_rip, brent_63d_ret)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT-FILTERED FORWARD RETURN SERIES — split by regime
# =============================================================================

# Demand-driven regime forward returns
demand_post5d  = where(is_demand_rip, fx_post5d)
demand_post10d = where(is_demand_rip, fx_post10d)
demand_post20d = where(is_demand_rip, fx_post20d)

# Supply shock regime forward returns
supply_post5d  = where(is_supply_rip, fx_post5d)
supply_post10d = where(is_supply_rip, fx_post10d)
supply_post20d = where(is_supply_rip, fx_post20d)

# =============================================================================
# HIT RATE HELPERS — per regime, per FX pair
# =============================================================================
# USDCAD: oil rip → CAD strengthens → USDCAD falls → negative return is "hit"
# EURUSD: oil rip → USD weakens → EURUSD rises → positive return is "hit"
# AUDUSD: oil rip → AUD strengthens → AUDUSD rises → positive return is "hit"

# Demand regime hit series
usdcad_d_hit20 = where(is_demand_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d < 0 else 0.0)
eurusd_d_hit20 = where(is_demand_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)
audusd_d_hit20 = where(is_demand_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)

# Supply regime hit series
usdcad_s_hit20 = where(is_supply_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d < 0 else 0.0)
eurusd_s_hit20 = where(is_supply_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)
audusd_s_hit20 = where(is_supply_rip, 1.0 if fx_post20d > 0 else 0.0)

# Asset identity flags for per-row hit rate routing
is_usdcad = is_asset_ref(ticker="USDCAD")()
is_eurusd = is_asset_ref(ticker="EURUSD")()
is_audusd = is_asset_ref(ticker="AUDUSD")()

# Routed hit rate 20d — demand regime
d_hit20 = conditional_select(is_usdcad, usdcad_d_hit20, is_eurusd, eurusd_d_hit20, audusd_d_hit20)

# Routed hit rate 20d — supply regime
s_hit20 = conditional_select(is_usdcad, usdcad_s_hit20, is_eurusd, eurusd_s_hit20, audusd_s_hit20)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 1: Brent 63-day rolling return with 50% event threshold
# =============================================================================

xy_lines(
    title='Brent Crude 63-Day Rolling Return',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    y_axis_label='63-Day Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Brent 63d Return', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.30, title='30% Rip Threshold', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, brent_63d_ret)

# =============================================================================
# CHART 2: Demand-Driven Rips — Avg FX Forward Return by Horizon
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Demand-Driven Rips: Avg FX Forward Return (2009, 2020)',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series_names=['Post-5d', 'Post-10d', 'Post-20d'],
    order=1
)((demand_post5d, demand_post10d, demand_post20d))

# =============================================================================
# CHART 3: Supply Shock Rips — Avg FX Forward Return by Horizon
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Supply Shock Rips: Avg FX Forward Return (2008, 2011, 2022)',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    y_axis_label='Avg Forward Return',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series_names=['Post-5d', 'Post-10d', 'Post-20d'],
    order=2
)((supply_post5d, supply_post10d, supply_post20d))

# =============================================================================
# TABLE: Combined regime comparison — event count, avg returns, hit rate 20d
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='Brent Oil Rip: Demand vs Supply Shock FX Impact',
    category='Brent Oil Rip & FX',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='Brent Oil Rip: Demand vs Supply Shock FX Impact',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='D: Event Count',  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,  grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='D: Avg 5d',        type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='D: Avg 10d',       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='D: Avg 20d',       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='D: Hit Rate 20d',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='S: Event Count',  type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0,  grid_agg=AggregationType.Count),
            ColumnSpec(title='S: Avg 5d',        type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='S: Avg 10d',       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='S: Avg 20d',       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='S: Hit Rate 20d',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=3
)(demand_post5d, demand_post5d, demand_post10d, demand_post20d, d_hit20,
  supply_post5d, supply_post5d, supply_post10d, supply_post20d, s_hit20)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Demand-Driven rips (green) and Supply Shock rips (red)
# =============================================================================

# Demand-driven events — green upward arrow
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Demand-Driven Oil Rip (2009 / 2020)',
        icon=Icon.ArrowUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,    title='Brent 63d Return',   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-5d Return',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_demand_rip, ev_brent_ret_demand, demand_post5d, demand_post10d, demand_post20d)

# Supply shock events — red downward arrow
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Supply Shock Oil Rip (2008 / 2011 / 2022)',
        icon=Icon.ArrowDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero,    title='Brent 63d Return',   type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-5d Return',  type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-10d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='FX Post-20d Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_supply_rip, ev_brent_ret_supply, supply_post5d, supply_post10d, supply_post20d)
